title: feat(mobile): Complete P5 Mobile User Experience roadmap
body:
Implements all remaining P5 Mobile UX items from the roadmap. Many items were already implemented but unchecked; this PR fills the gaps and marks everything complete.

### Form Controls — Touch Targets & Responsive Sizing
- `min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-0` on Input, Textarea, Checkbox, Switch, SelectTrigger
- `text-xs sm:text-sm` on FormLabel
- WizardForm step circles: `h-6 w-6 sm:h-8 sm:w-8`

### Pull-to-Refresh Integration
- Integrated `usePullToRefresh` from `@object-ui/mobile` into ObjectGrid, ObjectCalendar, ListView
- Pattern: `refreshKey` state → `useCallback` handler → hook → wrapper div with pull indicator

```tsx
const { ref: pullRef, isRefreshing, pullDistance } = usePullToRefresh<HTMLDivElement>({
  onRefresh: () => setRefreshKey(k => k + 1),
  enabled: !!dataSource && !!schema.objectName,
});
```

### DataTable
- Horizontal scroll indicator via `shadow-[inset_-8px_0_8px_-8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]`

### PWA & Mobile Infrastructure
- `MobileProvider` wrapping Console app root
- `manifest.json` created and linked in `index.html`
- `loading="lazy"` on below-fold images (aspect-ratio, signature field)
- Added `@object-ui/mobile` dependency to plugin-grid, plugin-calendar, plugin-list, console

### E2E Mobile Viewport Tests
- New `e2e/mobile-viewport.spec.ts` covering iPhone SE (375px), iPhone 14 (390px), iPad Mini (768px)
- Asserts: no JS errors, no blank page, viewport meta, manifest link, no horizontal overflow, touch target compliance

### ROADMAP.md
- 65 P5 items checked off after code audit confirmed implementation
